caption: Figure 4.24 Some mammals : (a) Ornithorhynchus (b) Macropus (c) Pteropus (d) Balaenoptera
note: Four-panel plate of mammal illustrations; the only printed labels on the artwork are the panel letters, given here in printed panel sequence (on the page (a) sits under the platypus at left, (b) under the kangaroo at centre bottom, (c) under the bat at upper right and (d) under the whale at lower right). The genus names Ornithorhynchus, Macropus, Pteropus and Balaenoptera are printed in italics in the caption. The heading "4.2.11.7 Class - Mammalia", the body text above the artwork and the footer "2024-25" are not part of this figure.
